name: immich-cull
subtitle: Swipe through your Immich library and cull it.
description: The source for immich-cull, a native iOS app for quickly culling photos and videos on a self-hosted Immich server. Unofficial and not affiliated with the Immich project.

apps.name: immich-cull
apps.subtitle: Cull your Immich library by swiping.
apps.localizedDescription:
A native iOS app for quickly culling photos and videos on a self-hosted Immich server. Swipe through your library one image at a time and bin, favourite, or file each shot into an album — without waiting on a web UI.

Unofficial and independent: immich-cull is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the Immich project or its maintainers.

• Swipe to cull. An interactive pager like the Photos app, with every direction mapped to an action you choose — trash, favourite, add to album, next, previous, or undo.
• Going back doesn't undo. Stepping back to the previous image leaves what you did to it alone. Undo still reverses everything, on the server.
• Reviewed photos stay reviewed. Moving past an asset tags it in Immich so it isn't offered again next run.
• Pick your scope. The whole roll, one album, or the "Not in Any Album" pile.
• Browse and bulk-trash. Open any album as a full-screen grid, drag-select across it, and move the lot to the trash in one step.
• Photos, videos, or both — switchable mid-run. Videos play muted inline while you review them.
• Trash bin. A live badge counts what's in the Immich trash; open it to restore, permanently delete, or empty it.
• Local cleanup. Optionally remove the matching item from the iPhone's own photo library when you trash it.
• Stats, and a system / light / dark appearance setting.

Requires a reachable Immich server and an API key (Immich web UI → Account Settings → API Keys). Credentials are stored in the iOS Keychain.

immich-cull talks only to the Immich server you point it at: no analytics, no telemetry, no third-party dependencies. Free software under the GNU GPL v3.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: ImmichCull scans your local network to find Immich servers.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ImmichCull can remove photos you trash from this iPhone's photo library.

versions.localizedDescription:
**New: immich-cull for macOS.** A keyboard-first Mac app with the same culling engine as the iOS app: browse the library, the unsorted pile, or any album; multi-select like Photos; and cull with configurable shortcuts. Download the `.dmg` below.

**New on both:**
- Turn "offer already-culled photos" on or off straight from the filter menu, in the deck and the browse grids.

**Fixes on both:**
- Libraries over 5,000 items no longer stall once the first 5,000 are culled.
- Trashed items are removed from your Photos library when you leave culling, even if you stop partway through.
- A trash or undo the server rejects is rolled back instead of silently counted, and an undo made just before closing still reaches the server.
- Safer Photos matching: a photo with no capture date is never deleted on filename alone.
- Restoring or deleting a Live Photo in the trash now includes its motion part.
- Nested tags (e.g. `Trips/culled`) are matched and written correctly.
- Session and lifetime counters no longer drift after undo or going back.
- Grids show album-membership badges and follow your review order; the trash badge updates immediately.
